name: W1061 - Web - Source Code & Developer Tools Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Web upload into the Unauthorized Source Code surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before code or developer artifacts are pushed to non-sanctioned source-control platforms (public GitHub, personal GitLab, etc.). Exclusions: excludes domains in Websites_Authorized_Source_Code_&_Developer_Tools_Domains_[is]; tune by populating with corporate SCM instances (GitHub Enterprise, internal GitLab) so sanctioned repo work doesn't warn developers.
